Antwerp's polished diamonds are now worth 32 times as much as its rough ones, and the gap widened fast this year.

Polished exports rose 17.34% a carat to $2,666.92 in the seven months to July, while rough fell 25.82% to $82.66. The July month alone shows the polished surge cooling to just 3.32%, so read the full-year figure with that caveat attached.

Gold traded at $4,444.80 this morning as three metals fell and silver alone gained, up 0.94% to $66.88.

Platinum slid 1.21% to $1,797 and palladium fell 2.21% to $1,374, though its own $40 bid-ask spread ran wider than the day's move, at 2.91%. Gold/silver ratio: 66.46, in from 67.23 Friday.
